name: firewall-log
description: OPNsense/pfSense filterlog, Suricata/Zenarmor alerts, Home Assistant or router syslog lines. Separates real threats from scanner noise.

category.instructions: What does this network or firewall log entry most likely represent?

criteria.internet_scan_noise: Inbound blocked connection attempts from the internet to closed or filtered ports; mass scanners, Shodan-style probes, background radiation
criteria.ids_alert: An IDS/IPS signature match (Suricata, Snort, Zenarmor) describing an exploit, malware, command-and-control, or policy violation
criteria.internal_anomaly: Traffic from an internal host that is unusual: an IoT device contacting unexpected destinations, lateral movement, a LAN host scanning other hosts, DNS to non-approved resolvers
criteria.config_or_service: Gateway down/up, DHCP, WAN IP change, certificate expiry, VPN tunnel state, service restarts, rule reloads
criteria.auth_event: Login success or failure to the firewall, VPN, SSH, or web UI
criteria.benign: Normal allowed traffic, routine housekeeping, or anything with no security or availability consequence

threat.instructions: How much risk does this entry indicate for a home or small-office network?
criteria: Low: suspicious but blocked or inconsequential
Medium: plausible compromise attempt or misconfiguration worth checking
High: likely compromise, successful unauthorized access, or active exfiltration

outbound_from_lan.instructions: Did this traffic originate from inside the local network (a private RFC1918 or ULA source address) heading outward?

was_allowed.instructions: Was this traffic allowed or passed rather than blocked or dropped?
